cityStatistic.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost for Tokyo? Hotel Prices for Tokyo, Japan | Budget Your Trip
cityStatistic.evidenceText: Average 1-Star Hotel Price in Tokyo, Japan: with data for 312 hotels, $104 is the average price for 1-star hotels in Tokyo, and the median price is $77.
cityStatistic.referencePeriod: Budget Your Trip Tokyo hotel-price analysis; testing subdomain result crawled 3 weeks before 2026-07-31; one-night prices before taxes and fees
cityStatistic.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Tokyo Japan 1 star hotel average price
cityStatistic.reason: Accepted as an exact Tokyo city-level Budget Your Trip 1-star average with a visible 312-hotel sample and USD currency. The testing subdomain is retained as a provenance warning; occupancy remains source-default and this calibration row is not an observed two-adult product anchor.

explicitQuotes.evidenceText: Booking.com returned Tokyo properties with 2-adult/1-room contexts but no explicit one-star class; Hotels.com returned a one-star category page with a lowest-nightly-price statement but no eligible numeric named-property quote.
explicitQuotes.referencePeriod: Search results crawled 6 days to last week before 2026-07-31; no qualifying dated quote
explicitQuotes.searchQuery: site:hotels.com Tokyo Japan 1-star hotel 2 adults 1 room price
explicitQuotes.reason: Not found under the strict paired contract. Generic or class-ambiguous Booking.com properties and Hotels.com lowest/from category results were rejected; no explicit two-adult one-star property quote was promoted.
